title: gen3 failure decomposition and strategy ceilings
finding: Perception is sufficient (no capture without warning; median 5 s warning). gen3 flees in the open (52% dash) and runs through shelters (64% dash inside) instead of hiding; it leaves shelter while still sensing the predator (73%). Reactive hiding is nearly worthless here (oracle 645 ticks); preemptive avoidance works (oracle 1069). With Vela's own senses, survival rises monotonically with cue memory (724 → 933 ticks).
cause_hypothesis: The winning strategy needs memory of recent predator percepts and a horizon long enough to value staying hidden (gamma 0.99 ≈ 10 s).
change: gen4: 2×2 controlled experiment on world 2.2.0 (memory inputs on/masked × gamma 0.99/0.997), 2 seeds per cell.
